t: Din erub lechatzer sheharbeh bene adam darim betoko
s: Din erub lechatzer sheharbeh bene adam darim betoko ubo y"ch seipim: chatzer sheharbeh battim petuchim letokah — min hattora muttarim letaltel bekol hechatzer umibbattehem lechatzer, shehare reshut hayyachid gemura hi. Abal chakamim aseru letaltel mibbattehem lechatzer ad sheyyearebu, mippene shehabbattim hem reshuyyot meyuchadot, lekol echad shello, vehechatzer hi reshut meshuttepet lekullam vedomeh qetzat lirshut harabbim, veim hayu motziim mehabbattim lechatzer, yomru shemmuttar lehotzi mereshut hayyachid lirshut harabbim. Abal hittiru al yede erub, sheggobin pat mikkol bayit ubayit venotenim otam beechad mibbatte hechatzer, sheatta anu roim keillu kullam darim beoto bayit, lepi sheddato shel adam vedirato bimqom mezonotayv hi, ukeillu kol hechatzer meyuchedet leoto bayit, veenah doma lirshut harabbim. Vaapillu mibbayit lebayit shello bederek hechatzer asur letaltel beli erub, sheasu seyag lattora leharchiq, shello lehotzi mereshut shel zeh lirshut shel zeh ap al pi sheshtehen reshut hayyachid, kede shello yabou lehotzi mereshut hayyachid lirshut harabbim. Abal keshehinnichu erub beachad habbattim, venaasu keillu kullam darim beoto bayit beshuttaput — hare en kan ella dira achat, ushear habbattim hem kechadre dira zo, vehakkol reshut achat. Vehu haddin vehu hattaam betiltul mechatzer lechatzer sheetzlah leinyan kelim sheshshabetu babbayit, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sha"b:

Yoshebe ohalim o sukkot, veken machaneh shehiqqipuhu mechitztza, en metaltelin meohel leohel ad sheyyearebu kullam, ella im ken holekim lammilchama, sheaz petarum chakamim meerube chatzerot uminnetilat yadayim (vaapillu hi milchemet hareshut). Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemachaneh haqqabua veomed sham yamim. Abal shayyara haholeket ledarkah, venachu sham mippene hashshabbat — peturim milleareb, mippene sheen otam ohalim qebuim lahem sham vekimorabim hem:

Battim shebbispina tzerikim erub, ap al pi sheyyesh lassepina mechitztzot ureshut hayyachid hi. Abal otam sheen lahem battim, hare hem kishruyim bechatzer achat veenam tzerikim erub (veken enam oserim al haddar babbayit shebbassepina, veen tzarik leareb ella im ken hem shenayim bishne battim, sheaz hem oserim zeh al zeh beli erub). Veematay hassepina hi reshut hayyachid, vedin hattiltul mimmenna layyam — nitbaer besimman shn"h:

Habbayit shemmanniach bo haerub en tzarik litten pat, shehare haerub eno ella shennechshabim keillu kullam darim sham, vahare baal habbayit zeh dar sham. Veen tzarik sheyyihyeh baerub shaveh peruta kede sheal yado yihyeh niqneh lahem bayit zeh ladur bo, ella day bemah shennechshabim shehem darim bo ap al pi sheeno qanuy lahem ladur bo. Ulepikak mannichin erub apillu bebayit shel qatan, ap al pi shehaqqatan en lo daat lehaqnot lahem beto, veken qatan yakol ligbot haerub uleqabbetzo ulehannicho babbayit. Veap al pi sheen bemaaseh haqqatan kelum, mikkol maqom haerub naaseh meelayv keshehunnach babbayit, vaapillu hunnach shello leshem erub, kemo sheyyitbaer. Umikkol maqom al yede nokri asur leqabbetzo lekattechilla (shehannokri eno neeman alayv):

Hoil vehaerub hu mishshum dira, en mannichin oto ella bebayit harauy ledira, abal lo beaksadra umirpeset velo bebet shaar, sheap al pi shehu bayit gamur, eno rauy ledira mippene haoberim derek alayv. Velo bebayit sheen bo d' ammot al d' ammot, sheen dirato chashuba dira (vaapillu hu arok harbeh, im en berochbo d' ammot — eno chashub dira, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman rp"v). Velaken eno oser bechatzer ubammaboy, ap al pi shello ereb immahem:

Vehamminhag bizman hazzeh lehanniach haerub bebet hakkeneset, ap al pi shebbet hakkeneset eno rauy ledira mippene qedushshato, ap shehu bayit gamur, shehare haddira hu meqom haakila, veasur leekol bebet hakkeneset im lo hallomedim sham, kemo shennitbaer besimman qn"a. Veyesh shennatenu taam lamminhag, lepi sheerubin shellanu yesh lahem din shittup meboot, dehaynu shekkol hachatzerot vehabbattim shebbammaboy mishtattepin yachad beerub zeh, veshittupe meboot en tzarik lehannicho kelal bebet dira, raq sheyyehe bemaqom hammishtammer bilbad, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shp"v. Umeqomot sheen lahem lechi o qora limbootehem, o shebbet hakkeneset eno bemaboy hammetuqqan belechi o qora, sheen mannichim sham erub bebet hakkeneset, kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"h — ap al pi ken muttarim letaltel bebet hakkeneset (umimmennu lachatzar bet hakkeneset, vaapillu im yesh sham dira achat bachatzar bet hakkeneset, ella im ken yesh bah shette dirot, sheaz hen oserot zo al zo ad sheyyearebu benehen, veim lo erebu — asur lekol adam letaltel bachatzar bet hakkeneset. Abal im en bah ella dira achat — nittenet kulla ledira zo), veen anshe bet hakkeneset oserim aleha, hoil ubet hakkeneset enah bet dira (ukemo sheyyitbaer besimman sha"v gabbe churba sheetzel bet dira), vekol bene hair naasu keorechim legabbe dira zo, umuttarim gam ken letaltel mechatzer lebet hakkeneset uledira zo kemo shemmuttarim bishar chatzerot sheen bahem ella bayit echad:

Im regilin litten tamid et haerub bebayit yadua — en lahem leshannoto velitteno bebayit acher, mippene darke shalom. Vaapillu yesh qetzat taam leshannoto, en meshannin. Abal im yesh taam gadol — meshannin. Veim bitchillat hannachato sham hitnu leshannot, muttarim leshannot. Veim met baal habbayit zeh, o shemmakar beto leacher — ap al pi ken en meshannin keshello hitnu, mippene sheinyan haddarke shalom bekan hu mishshum chashad, shello yisberu shechoshedin baal habbayit zeh sheggoneb pat min haerub ulekak motziin oto mimmennu lebayit acher, veshemma mittok kak yabo lide machaloqet immahem. Velazeh yesh lachush gam beloqeach veyoresh. Vekol zeh beerub shemmannichin oto babbayit bechinnam, veken kol kayyotze bazeh. Abal dabar shetztzerikin litten maot lezeh — yekolin leshannot litten leacher. Ubekullan, im aberu venatenu bebayit acher — en motziin mimmennu:

Tzarik shello yaqpid shum echad mehem al erubo im yoklennu chabero. Veim maqpid — eno erub, ki mah shemo? "Erub" shemo, sheyyihyu kullam meorabim umerutztzim bo, shello yimcheh echad bachabero ella shuttapot nocha vaareba. Velaken tzarik lizzaher shello leareb bedabar shettiqqen letzorek hashshabbat, shehare im yebaqshennu chabero mimmennu — lo yittenennu lo:

Tzarik litten kol haerub bikli echad, veim chilleqo unetano bishne kelim — eno erub, shehare "erub" shemo, sheyyihyu meorabim. Vehu shechilleqo middaat, meezeh taam sheyyihyeh. Abal im nitmalle keli haechad, yakol litten hammotar bikli sheni, vehu sheyyihyu shene kelim bebayit echad:

En meorbin biprusa, apillu hi gedola harbeh, shemma yabou lide machaloqet, sheechad yitten shelema veyomar "ani noten shelema veatta perusa", vehaerub tzarik lihyot shuttaput nocha vaareba. Vaapillu im kullam yirtzu litten perusot — asur, shemma yachazor haddabar leqilqulo, sheechad yitten shelema veyabou lide machaloqet. Abal bishlema meorbin apillu hi qetanna meod, ubilbad sheyyihyu sham kikkarot harbeh, sheyyehe bahen kashshiur sheyyitbaer besimman shs"ch. Veim lo nittal mimmenna ella kede challat nachtom, shehu cheleq a' mim"ch — meorbin bah, apillu lo hayeta tebula lechalla keshennittal mimmenna cheleq zeh, lepi shehashshekenim enam yodeim shello hayeta tebula lechalla, veyisberu shechallatah hi shennittela mimmenna, velo yabou lide machaloqet. Veim nipresa vechibberah beqisam, shehiknis qatzeh echad bappat veqatzeh hashsheni bapperusa, im enah nikkeret shennipresa — meorbin bah (veap al pi sheenah kishlema gemura, kemo shennitbaer besimman qs"ch, mikkol maqom kevan sheenah nikkeret lashshekenim, lo yabou lide machaloqet). Veim echad mezakkeh lekullam mishshello — yakol leareb apillu biprusa, shekkan en lachush lemachaloqet. Veyesh sheppereshu mah sheameru "en meorbin ella bishlema" shezzehu kol haerub beyachad, sheyyihyeh pat shelema (ap al pi shekkol echad lo natan shelema), velaken nahagu leqabbetz mikkol bayit ubayit meat qemach veosin challa achat shelema umeorbin bah. Vetzarik lehazhir lehashshammash sheyyehe bachalla kashshiur sheyyitbaer besimman shs"ch. Veap al pi shennishtayyer min haqqemach velo naasa mikkullo challa — en bekak kelum, lepi sheal daat ken natenu qimcham mittechilla, shello teaseh hachalla mikkol haqqemach, vahare zeh keillu natenu kol echad qimcho lachabero bemattana, sheim teaseh hachalla miqqimcho yizkeh bah kol haqqahal, shehare i epshar sheyyihyeh erub beinyan acher. Veap al pi shehannoten erub bead chabero tzarik lezakkot lo al yede acher, kemo sheyyitbaer, mikkol maqom kan keshennoten kol echad qimcho lehashshammash leareb bo — anu choshebin keillu notenim lo sheyyizkeh bo bishbil kullam, veen hashshammash tzarik lezakkot lahem al yede acher (o al yede atzmo beperush). Veyesh mi sheomer sheim lo zikka hashshammash lahem al yede acher (o al yede atzmo beperush) — eno erub. Vetob lachush lidbarayv lekattechilla, ubiprat im hashshammash asahu miqqemach shello (venatal qemach haqqahal leatzmo). Veken nohagin, shehashshammash noten haerub leharab, sheyyizkeh bo bishbil kol haqqahal. Venohagin laasot haerub bematztza beereb pesach lekol hashshana, mittaam sheyyitbaer besimman shs"ch. Veim choshka lel yom tob velo zikka lahem — asur lezakkoto beyom tob ella al tenay, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shtz"g. Veim yom tob eno samuk leshabbat, en lezakkoto beyom tob al tenay, ella yamtin ad ereb shabbat. Veim shakach lezakkoto ad shabbat, muttarim letaltel bair, shebbediabad yesh lismok al sebara harishona (umikkol maqom achar hashshabbat yezakkennu lahem belo beraka):
En meorbin erube chatzerot ella bepat. Umeorbin apillu bepat shel orez o adashim, abal lo bepat dochan:

Echad mibbene hechatzer yakol litten pat bishbil kullam apillu shello bipnehem, ubilbad sheyyezakkennu lahem al yede acher, dehaynu shehaacher yagbihennu bishbil sheyyizku bo kullam behagbaha zo keillu higbihuhu beatzman, sheshshelucho shel adam kemoto. Veap shehem lo asauhu shalich, mikkol maqom zakin leadam shello bepanayv. Abal al yede atzmo eno yakol lezakkoto lahem, shekkol zeman shehu beyado lo yatza mereshuto. Vekamma yagbihennu? Tepach. Vaapillu im hinnichu lo al yado hammugbahat uteluya baavir, tzarik sheyyagbiah yado tepach. Ukeshehu mezakkeh, im baqi bahalaka hu — tzarik lezakkoto lekol bene hechatzer o hammaboy ulekol mi sheyyittosep alehem miyyom zeh veelak, sheim lo ken peamim sheyyittosepu diyyurin veyaasru alehem. Veyesh omerim sheakshav shemmeorbin bitchillat shana lekol shabbetot hashshana, ap al pi shennittosepu diyyurim en tzarik lehosip baerub bishbilam, shebbitchilla mitkavvenim lezakkoto lekol habba. Veap al pi sheen mezakkin lahem beperush, leb bet din matneh alehem (veyesh lismok al dibrehem bediabad lehaqel bedibre soperim). Veim nittosepu diyyurin achar shennitmaet haerub mishshiuro, ap al pi shekkol shennishtayyer mimmennu kol shehu, kasher hu, sheshshiyyure erub kol shehu veen tzarik shiur ella bitchillato, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shs"ch — mikkol maqom tzarik lehosip alayv mechamat haddiyyurin shennittosepu atta, shellahem hu techillat erub. Vaapillu zikkuhu lahem beperush bitchillato, mikkol maqom kol zeman shello hayu darim kan lo haya lahem erub kelal, sheerub hu mishshum dira:

Keshemmezakkeh lahem al yede acher, lo yezakkeh al yede beno ubitto haqqetannim apillu enam semukim al shulchano, velo al yede abdo veshipchato hakkenaanim, mippene sheyyadan keyado velo yatza haerub mereshuto. Abal mezakkeh hu al yede beno ubitto haggedolim apillu hem semukim al shulchano. Veap al pi sheyyadan keyado leinyan metzia — shemmetziatan laabihem — zeh eno ella mishshum eba, shello yimna mehem mezonot im tehe metziatan leatzman, abal bemah shehaab rotzeh lezakkot laacherim al yede beno, zokim hem laacherim kishar kol adam. Veal yede abdo veshipchato haibrim, apillu hem qetannim, shehaqqatan zokeh apillu laacherim bedabar sheeno ella middibre soperim. Veal yede ishto, ap al pi shemmaaleh lah mezonot, shemmetziatah umaaseh yadeha shello veyadah keyado — mikkol maqom, kevan sheim natan lah adam acher mattana al menat sheen lebalah reshut bah, zokta bah, hu haddin shebbalah atzmo yakol lezakkot al yadah. Veyesh omerim sheeno mezakkeh al yede beno ubitto hassemukim al shulchano apillu hem gedolim, hoil umetziatam shello veyadam keyadan. Velo al yede bitto, apillu enah semuka al shulchano, kol zeman shello bogra, shemmetziatah gam ken shello mishshum eba, shello yimserenna limnuvval umukkeh shechin. Velo al yede ishto shemmaaleh lah mezonot o sheamar lah "tzei maaseh yadayik bimzonotayik", shemmetziatah gam ken shello. Vaapillu yesh lah bayit bipne atzmah bechatzer zo o bemaboy zeh, en omerim: mittok shehi zoka beerub zeh leatzmah bishbil betah, zoka hi gam ken laacherim, lepi shehi enah zoka bo kelal leatzmah, mippene sheenah tzerika lo kelal, shekkevan shehu mezakkeh mishshello laacherim — bevadday haerub yehe munnach bebeto, veim ken enah oseret al balah ap al pi shello ereba immo, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"a. Abal mezakkeh hu al yede beno sheeno samuk al shulchano, apillu hu qatan, kevan shemmetziato shello, veal yede bitto shebbogra veenah semuka al shulchano, veal yede ishto sheeno maaleh lah mezonot, vaapillu en lah bayit bechatzer, kevan shemmetziatah shellah. Uleinyan halaka, bemaqom sheepshar tob lachush ledibre shenehem, lehachamir bibno qatan sheeno samuk al shulchano kisbara harishona, ubibno gadol ubitto bogeret hassemukot al shulchano, ubenaara apillu enah semuka al shulchano, ubeishto shemmaaleh lah mezonot kisbara haacharona. Vekol zeh lekattechilla, abal bediabad somekin al dibre hammeqel beerub (vaapillu lekattechilla, bemaqom shei epshar beinyan acher yesh lehaqel kisbara harishona, shehu iqqar):

Uledibre hakkol gadol sheyyesh lo ishsha en yado keyad abiv, veap al pi shessamuk al shulchan abiv, yakol lezakkot lekattechilla al yado. Veken acher hassamuk al shulchano, kegon mi shemmegaddel yatom bebeto, yakol lezakkot al yado ledibre hakkol, mippene sheen yado keyad baal habbayit umetziato shello mittaam sheyyitbaer bechoshen mishpat simman a"r:

Hamzakkeh laacherim mishshello eno tzarik lehodia lahem qodem hashshabbat sheereb alehem, ella modiam beshabbat vehem muttarim letaltel. Veap al pi shebbishat qeniyyat haerub, shehu ben hashshemashot (kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shatz"[g]), lo yadeu mimmennu kelal — en bekak kelum, sheqqeniyyat erub zeh zekut hu lahem, vezakin leadam shello middato:

Bene hechatzer shehayu mesubbim leekol bebet echad mehem veqiddesh alehem hayyom — happat sheal hashshulchan somekin alayv mishshum erub, apillu hu pat shel baal habbayit lebaddo. Veap al pi shehamareb mishshello tzarik lezakkot, bekan setamo keperusho, shekkol shezzimmen leekol al hashshulchan hare zikka lahem et hakkol. Veap al pi shello hunnach happat al hashshulchan leshem erub — en bekak kelum. Vehu shemmesubbin babbayit, shehu maqom harauy lehannachat erub. Abal im mesubbin bechatzer — eno erub, shehare haerub tzarik lihyot bebet dira. Veken bene hechatzer sheyyesh lahem pat beshuttaput lischora enam tzerikim leareb kelal im happat munnach bebet dira, ap al pi shello hunnach sham leshem erub kelal:

Appoteroppos shel qatan yakol leareb bead haqqatan apillu mishshel haqqatan shello middato, mippene shehu lo keben bayit, sheyyakol leareb mishshel baal habbayit shello middato, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shs"z:

Mitzva lachazor achar erube chatzerot, kede shello yabou letaltel beissur. Vetzarik lebarek alayv "asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv vetzivvanu al mitzvat erub", kemo shetztzarik lebarek al kol mitzvot shel dibrehem. Veomer "beden eruba yehe shara lana leappuqe uleayyule min habbattim lechatzer umin hechatzer lebattim umibbayit lebayit lekol habbattim shebbechatzer". Venusach shellanu yitbaer besimman shtz"h. Veematay mebarek? Beshaa shemmeqabbetz oto mibbene hechatzer o beshaa shemmezakkeh lahem, mippene shekkol hammitzvot mebarek alehem ober laasiyyatan. Uleminhag medinot ellu shehashshammash oseh haerub bechalla sheopeh mehaqqemach sheqqibbetz, im eno mezakkeh lahem hare habberaka hi achar shennaasa haerub mimmela keshenneepa hachalla, veap al pi ken hi ober laasiyyatan, mippene shekkol shello niknas shabbat adayin lo qana erub, sheqqeniyyat erub hi ben hashshemashot (ulepi zeh adam acher sheeno dar beir zo eno yakol lebarek beraka zo, shekkevan sheeno shayyak beerub zeh — al ma yebarek? Veeno domeh lishar mitzvot, shehaoseh mitzva laacherim yakol lebarek al asiyyatah mippene shehu oseh otah lahem, abal kan eno oseh kelum, shehaerub naasa kebar mimmela). Abal haiqqar kemo shennitbaer lemala, shehashshammash yezakkeh lahem haerub, vibarek beshaa shemmezakkeh o hu o hazzokeh lahem (vaapillu eno dar beir zo). Veim gabu haerub velo bereku alayv velo ameru alayv kelum — en habberaka vehaamira meakkebet, umuttarim letaltel mibbattim lechatzer:
